Miner-influenced timestamp passed as the Uniswap deadline in addLiquidity and _swap.

onlyOwner setter that replaces the marketing wallet that receives ETH during _swap.
onlyOwner setter that replaces the treasury wallet that receives ETH during _swap.

onlyOwner toggle that activates trading on the Uniswap pair.
Public payable function that increases ethReflectionBasis with the raw ETH value sent.
Core transfer override that applies taxes, claims reflections, triggers _swap and enforces max transfer limits.

Public entry point allowing msg.sender to claim their ETH reflection.

Public unrestricted function that forces a swap of the contract's token balance.
onlyOwner function that transfers the entire contract ETH balance to the owner.
Internal function that moves the taxed token amount to the contract and accrues marketing/treasury/reflection totals.
Internal view helper computing send/reflect/marketing/treasury splits from configured rates.
Internal un-taxed balance transfer used by _transfer, _takeTaxes and rescue functions.
onlyOwner mint entry point that calls the internal _mint supply-capped logic.
onlyOwner batch mint to a list of accounts using parallel arrays.
onlyOwner emergency withdrawal of SIMP accrued as marketing fees.
onlyOwner emergency withdrawal of SIMP accrued as treasury fees.

Accrued reflection token amount tracked by _takeTaxes and reduced in _swap/rescue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the reflection claimant, so an untrusted caller drives the claim path.
claimReflection delegates to the internal _claimReflection logic.
_claimReflection sends ETH via transfer to an address derived from untrusted input before/after state writes.
_claimReflection writes lastReflectionBasis[addr] after computing the entitlement.
_claimReflection reads ethReflectionBasis to compute unclaimed reflection.
_transfer calls _claimReflection for both sender and recipient.
_transfer conditionally invokes _swap when the contract balance exceeds minTokenBalance.
_transfer performs the actual balance movements through _rawTransfer.
_transfer forwards computed marketing/treasury/reflect amounts to _takeTaxes.
_transfer reads the swapFees flag to decide whether to auto-swap.
_transfer reads the _inSwap reentrancy guard to avoid nested swaps.
_transfer requires tradingActive for any pair-involving transfer.
_transfer obtains the tax breakdown from _getTaxAmounts.
_swap makes an external router call for token->ETH swap which can re-enter via malicious tokens or router state.
_swap distributes ETH to marketing and treasury wallets via transfer after the external swap call.
The lockSwap modifier sets _inSwap around the _swap body.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controlled time.
addLiquidity forwards minted tokens and msg.value to the router's addLiquidityETH.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity approves and calls the cached _router instance.
withdrawAll transfers the whole contract ETH balance to the owner via an external call.
swapAll invokes the internal _swap routine on the clamped contract balance.
swapAll checks the _inSwap guard before calling _swap.
setMarketingWallet overwrites the privileged marketingWallet payout address.
setTreasuryWallet overwrites the privileged treasuryWallet payout address.
addReflection adds msg.value to ethReflectionBasis, an unbounded accumulator.
_takeTaxes moves the summed tax tokens to the contract through _rawTransfer.
_takeTaxes increments totalMarketing with the marketing tax.
_takeTaxes increments totalTreasury with the treasury tax.
_takeTaxes increments totalReflected with the reflection tax.
The constructor creates the Uniswap pair and stores it in _pair.
The constructor assigns the router address to _router.
The constructor marks owner, zero address, wallets and the contract as tax excluded.
rescueMarketingTokens moves tokens out via _rawTransfer.
rescueMarketingTokens decrements totalMarketing, relying on the require to avoid underflow.
enableTrading flips the tradingActive gate to true.
The _marketingWallet parameter flows directly into setMarketingWallet's assignment.
The _account parameter is the taxed sender consumed by _takeTaxes.
contractTokenBalance is the local amount used by _transfer to decide the swap size.
unclaimed is the local ETH amount computed and transferred by _claimReflection.
addr is the parameter that _claimReflection pays reflection ETH to.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only used to assign the marketingWallet state variable inside setMarketingWallet, so it can be folded into the function node.
The _account parameter is purely the sender whose tokens are moved and has no independent semantic role.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local in _transfer used only to bound the _swap amount.
unclaimed is a temporary local holding the computed ETH entitlement inside _claimReflection.
addr parameter is only the destination of the ETH transfer performed by _claimReflection.
